meta.notes: A storage block for nine rubies that also guards whoever stands on it. msm:on_step fires the event msm_starter:ruby_block_step when an entity steps on it, at most once every 20 ticks (one second). The event's only action is run_script, which calls the handler msm_starter:guard that the script msm_starter:ruby_block_guard defines. "loot": "self" generates a loot table that drops the block itself.
